name: smwmusic-piyopiyoplayer-cave-story-early-theme
title: PiyoPiyoPlayer - Cave Story (Early Theme)
description:
A very early theme from Cave Story, made by Pixel on his spare time, in a collection of songs from PiyoPiyoPlayer.

It does uses the KDL3 soundfont.

Original description by Pixel
Original:
○洞窟物語："洞窟物語"のテーマ曲になるはずだった。
Rough translation:
• Cave Story: It was supposed to be the theme song of "Cave Story".
